note: Frozen read API. This static site renders this snapshot; run the Go backend for live data.

/api/v1/alpha?days=90.note: Upper bound is perfect hindsight minus the best single venue, i.e. the entire value of routing with a crystal ball. A realistic keeper captures a fraction of it.

/api/v1/carry.note: Realised one-year return of a dollar deposited at each country's policy rate, converted back to dollars at today's rate. Uses the actual currency path, not a forecast. A managed currency can post a low volatility and still step sharply; the drawdown column exists for that. Not an offer, not advice, and not a product: no cross-border deposit is available through Ballast.

/api/v1/decisions.note: Every keeper evaluation, including the ones where nothing happened. A decision log that only shows successful moves is marketing, not a log.

/api/v1/meta.automation: policy-bounded: the vault enforces caps, cooldowns and a NAV check
/api/v1/meta.custody: non-custodial: the backend holds no key and signs nothing

chosen_by_measurement.cooldown_secs: average leadership between the two verified venues was ~6.7 days; a 7-day cooldown missed most switches
chosen_by_measurement.max_venue_share_of_cap: capped at 2% of a venue so our own exit does not become the risk
chosen_by_measurement.min_capacity_usd: venues under $100k cannot absorb our exit without moving the rate against us
chosen_by_measurement.min_improvement_bps: below 25 bps the switch costs more attention than it earns

/api/v1/policy.explain: These parameters are what a user signs once. The vault cannot exceed them, and the keeper cannot bypass them.

incidents.note: Aug 2026: Comet BLND-USDC pool (the backstop collateral for every Blend pool) was exploited; all backstops were impaired simultaneously and Stellar DeFi TVL fell ~60% intraday. This is why we never enter backstops or BLND-LP collateral.
Feb 2026: YieldBlox pool oracle fed from a shallow SDEX market was manipulated; ~$10.9M. Not a bug in Blend core code, but the same oracle plumbing.
